news.title: Odisha distributes housing benefits to five lakh beneficiaries under PMAY-Gramin
news.para: During the programme, 248 projects worth Rs 911.14 crore were also inaugurated by CM Majhi and their foundation stones were laid across Balangir district. The projects cover several sectors, including healthcare, drinking water, irrigation, Anganwadi centres, additional classrooms, roads and hostels.

news.title: Ahmedabad civic body plans smart upgrade for two lakh streetlight poles
news.para: The Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation is set to revamp streetlights and deploy an optical fiber network throughout the city. This initiative aims to transform streetlight poles into versatile platforms for telecom services and smart city innovations. It also involves implementing advanced controllers and monitoring systems to improve maintenance efficiency. Ensuring a minimum of 99% lighting during night hours is mandatory, with financial penalties in place for non-compliance to emphasize accountability.

news.title: Pune civic body moves to attach 33 properties of Sinhgad Institutes over ₹295-crore property tax dues
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation aims to recover Rs 295 crore in outstanding property taxes from Sinhgad Institutes by proposing the attachment of 33 of its properties. Despite previous enforcement attempts falling short, this new strategy seeks to auction off the properties if approved. Importantly, the corporation assures that the academic activities of the institutes will proceed without disruption throughout this recovery effort.

news.title: Government extends Lucknow civic body's one-time settlement scheme deadline for property tax
news.para: The Lucknow Municipal Corporation has announced an extension for its one-time settlement scheme, now lasting until December 14. Property owners have until January 15, 2027, to settle their outstanding house tax and water fees. In the last three months alone, the initiative raised Rs 24.82 crore from nearly 10,640 taxpayers, with Rs 10.31 crore relieved in interest for participants.

news.title: Varanasi civic body extends OTS deadline for 100% interest waiver on house tax dues
news.para: Building owners in Varanasi can now apply for a 100% waiver on interest for tax arrears until December 14. The extension has been announced by the Varanasi Municipal Corporation for public benefit. Eligible property owners are being reminded to take advantage of this opportunity through various communication methods. Notably, many owners still have not applied despite outstanding dues totaling Rs 295.67 crore.

news.title: Kolhapur civic body faces questions over move to regularise unauthorised constructions in Tawde Hotel area
news.para: KMC is facing criticism for purportedly attempting to legalize unauthorized buildings along the Kolhapur-Gandhinagar corridor. Concerns are being raised regarding how this action could affect legal standards and community interests. Former city officials have signaled legal repercussions if the administration moves forward against court directives. The administration is set to deliver a report that could sway future outcomes, spotlighting the ongoing clash between regulatory enforcement and existing constructions.

news.title: Proposed Himachal-Chandigarh township forces rethink of mining-hit hill restoration plan in Baddi
news.para: The Himachal Pradesh forest department has revised its ecological restoration plan for hills damaged by illegal mining. This modification comes after the announcement of the Him-Chandigarh township in Sheetalpur. The new plan focuses on plantation, soil conservation measures, and bio-engineering interventions to stabilize the slopes. The National Green Tribunal had previously mandated actions due to environmental damage complaints.

news.title: Visakhapatnam: VMRDA to hold two-day layout regularisation scheme mela to clear 3,100 pending applications
news.para: VMRDA is set to organize a special mela on November 17 and 18 aimed at addressing the backlog of pending applications. This event provides a unique opportunity for applicants to resolve issues relating to layout regularisation schemes. With an emphasis on expediting the resolution of deficiencies, objections, and missing paperwork for 3,100 applications, attendees are encouraged to bring all necessary documentation to ensure smooth processing.

news.title: Over 35 buildings sealed in three days in Gurugram over unauthorised commercial activities in residential properties
news.para: In a significant enforcement operation over three days, authorities sealed approximately 37 buildings in DLF-2 for engaging in unauthorized commercial activities. The Department of Town and Country Planning targeted properties on Bougainvillea Marg and Akashneem Marg to uphold land use standards. Property owners were warned against running unauthorized guesthouses and clinics, emphasizing the importance of adhering to building regulations for neighborhood integrity.

news.title: Mhajo flat scheme can tackle ownership and conveyance hurdles: Credai Goa
news.para: Credai officials anticipate that the new housing initiatives will grant residents formal housing rights, even for those lacking documentation. The Mhajo Flat program aims to rectify incomplete conveyance deeds in housing societies where original builders are absent. This initiative also facilitates long-term security for obtaining bank loans and transferring property rights.

news.title: Fresh NBCC auction for 49 flats in Delhi draws scrutiny
news.para: The government-owned NBCC has opened a new round of bidding for flats in Avenue Towers, Sarojini Nagar, following the annulment of previous highest bids and an adjustment in the reserve price. Buyers have expressed concerns about the arithmetic criteria used in this cancellation and how the new reserve price was determined. Furthermore, ongoing litigations regarding the property are not addressed in the bid documents.

news.title: El Niño threat puts construction sector in Hyderabad under water stress; builders pay three times more for water
news.para: Hyderabad's construction sector is grappling with a severe groundwater depletion crisis, forcing builders to rely on expensive private water tankers. This added financial burden is straining project budgets and extending timelines, especially for smaller projects that face ongoing monthly costs. Meanwhile, larger residential complexes require numerous tankers daily, intensifying the issue. As reservoir levels are anticipated to decrease even further, the pace of construction is expected to significantly diminish.

news.title: New World Development's shares tumble after $3.2 billion rights plan
news.para: Shares of New World Development plummeted over 30% following the announcement of a major rights issue. The company plans to offer 11 rights shares at a steep discount from its previous closing price. This decision aims to tackle its significant debt burden and enhance liquidity, with core shareholder Chow Tai Fook Enterprises fully supporting the initiative.

news.title: China's new home prices fall 2.4% in October; slowest annual decline in almost a year
news.para: In October, home prices in China fell by 0.1%, mirroring September's decline, while the annual decrease moderated to 2.4%, marking the slowest drop since November 2025. Shanghai stood out with rising prices in both new and resale markets. Struggling property investments and sales negatively impacted local economies, prompting the government to introduce measures aimed at stabilizing prices and boosting consumer spending.

news.title: Homebuyers' body FPCE seeks national appellate tribunal for real estate, similar to NCLAT, NGT
news.para: The Forum for People's Collective Efforts (FPCE) has called for enhanced accountability from state real estate regulatory authorities under the RERA framework. They advocate for a national appellate tribunal dedicated to safeguarding consumer rights nationwide. Additionally, the FPCE proposed several amendments, including a full refund policy for clients in distress.

news.title: HDFC Capital receives ₹1,100 crore exit from five House of Abhinandan Lodha projects
news.para: House of Abhinandan Lodha has recently returned approximately ₹1,100 crore to HDFC Capital Advisors. This return is part of their joint real estate platform established in 2023. The platform focuses on investing in plotted developments and low-rise residential projects. HDFC Capital originally committed around ₹1,500 crore to the platform across 11 projects. A financial advisor, TrustCap, facilitated the transactions for both companies.

news.title: Over 19 lakh rural families in Rajasthan get property cards under Swamitva scheme
news.para: Rajasthan has issued property documents to over 19 lakh rural families under the Swamitva Yojana. The state has achieved 99.4% of its drone mapping efforts in designated villages, with only a few remaining surveys left. Urgent directives have been given to district administrations to accelerate ground validation processes. Furthermore, property cards for an additional 14.

news.title: Mysuru ranks sixth in Karnataka in gram panchayat property tax collection for 2026-27
news.para: Mysuru district has impressively reached 94.1% of its property tax collection goal for the fiscal year 2026-27 as of October. The district’s 255 gram panchayats collectively gathered Rs 39.4 crore against a target of Rs 40.1 crore. Increased collections stemmed from proactive measures taken by the panchayat staff and improved governance. Notably, Periyapatna, Nanjangud, and T Narasipura led in tax generation.

news.title: Nagpur civic body collects just ₹179 crore property tax of total ₹750 crore demand
news.para: Nagpur Municipal Corporation is facing difficulties in collecting property taxes, having managed to collect only Rs179 crore against a total demand of over Rs750 crore. Despite the efforts of women's self-help groups in distributing 1.75 lakh demand notices, only 3.43 lakh property owners have paid up voluntarily. With time running out in the financial year, the civic body must ramp up its collection initiatives without delay.

news.title: Ahmedabad development body puts seven-km Thaltej-Godhavi Metro corridor on the fast track
news.para: The Ahmedabad Urban Development Authority has greenlit zoning reforms geared towards establishing the Thaltej-Godhavi metro corridor. This initiative aims to boost access to the South West Ahmedabad Sports Arena, timed with the Commonwealth Games. Spanning both urban and agricultural landscapes in Manipur and Godhavi, the plan strives to streamline land acquisition while developing necessary station facilities.
